title: Create your business page
welcome_title: A complete business page in a few short questions
welcome_sub: Answer a few simple questions and we'll write your page for you: description, category, tags, opening hours and products. You review everything before it goes live.
welcome_point_2: Your answers are saved as you go, so you can stop and come back
welcome_tip: Tip: there are no wrong answers. Write freely, the way you'd tell a friend. That makes the best page.
business_name_hint: As you want it to appear on the site
location_sub: Search for your address or drop the pin on the map. We use it to connect your business to the right local authority.
website_hint: We'll read details like opening hours and links from it, so you have less to write.
photos_sub: Show customers what it looks like. The first photo becomes your cover photo.
photos_hint: No good photos right now? That's fine, you can add them later.
magic_note: This is where the magic happens. A few words from you, and your page practically writes itself.
q_offer_sub: And what does a typical visit look like, from the moment customers arrive until they leave?
q_offer_probe: Tell us a bit more: what does the customer see, do and feel at each stage?
q_edge_sub: The thing you're proud of that sets you apart from similar businesses: a secret recipe, a view no one else has, personal service… You can also tell us how it all started.
q_edge_probe: Give one example: something customers always mention or take photos of?
q_fit_sub: Families? Couples? Groups? And who is it less suited for?
q_fit_probe: Tell us about one happy customer: who were they, and what happened?
q_reco_sub: If a happy customer recommended you to a friend in one sentence, what would they say?
products_title: What can customers book or buy?
products_sub: Add 2 to 4 things, such as a tour, a stay, a meal or a workshop. They're saved as drafts you can finish later. You can also skip this.
creating_sub: This usually takes less than a minute. Please keep this window open.
stage_writing: Writing your description and choosing categories
stage_saving: Saving your business and finding your local authority
error_body: Your answers are saved. Try again, or go back and check your answers.
err_phone: Enter an Israeli phone number, for example 050-1234567
err_email: Enter an email address, for example name@example.com
err_address: Choose your address from the list or drop the pin on the map
err_website: Enter a web address, for example https://example.com
err_answer: Write a few words so we can describe your business
err_product_name: Give this product a name, or remove it
err_product_price: Enter the price as a number, for example 120
cat_groups_title: What area is your business in?
cat_groups_sub: Pick every area that fits, up to 3. Next, you'll say exactly what you do.
cat_search_empty: No match. Pick the closest area, and you can add your own on the next step.
cat_max_groups: You can pick up to {{max}} areas. To switch, unselect one first.
cat_groups_hint: Not sure? Pick the closest one. You can always change it later.
cat_subs_sub: Select everything that fits. The starred one is your main activity: it shows first on your page and in search.
cat_none_yet: Nothing picked yet. Select what fits your business below.
cat_star_hint: Tap a star to choose the main one
cat_ai_note: These choices go to the AI as fixed facts. It writes your description and suggests tags based on them, instead of guessing your category.
err_subcategories: Select at least one thing you offer, or add your own
